sections.heading: Storefront Door and Frame Repair in Falls Church
sections.body: Storefront damage rarely affects glass alone. Heavy impacts and forced entry attempts often bend or misalign aluminum and steel door frames, damage door closers, or compromise the integrity of the surrounding glazing system. Our commercial glazing team handles full storefront door and frame repairs, including realigning frames, replacing damaged threshold components, and installing new tempered glass panels sized to your existing system. We work on a wide range of commercial door configurations, including single-door, double-door, and full-width storefront entrances common in Falls Church retail centers and office buildings. Whether your storefront is part of a strip mall, a stand-alone commercial building, or a ground-floor retail space in a multi-story development, we have the tools and experience to restore your entryway to safe, smooth operation. Properly functioning storefront doors also help maintain building security and climate control for your tenants.

sections.heading: Insulated Glass and Energy-Efficient Glazing Options for Storefronts
sections.body: Older storefronts in Falls Church often use single-pane glass that offers minimal thermal performance. When you are already investing in glass replacement after damage, it can be an ideal opportunity to upgrade to insulated glass units that provide better temperature control and reduced condensation. Insulated glazing units consist of two or more panes separated by a sealed air or gas-filled space, which helps maintain more consistent interior temperatures and can contribute to a more comfortable environment for employees and customers. We offer insulated glass options sized to fit most standard commercial storefront framing systems. While we do not guarantee specific energy savings outcomes or reference particular efficiency programs, upgrading to insulated glass is widely considered a practical long-term improvement for commercial buildings. Our team can walk you through the available glass options so you can make an informed decision that suits your building's needs and your budget.
